verses.text: His foundation is in the holy mountains.

segments.text: His foundation is in the holy mountains.

verses.text: Jehovah loveth the gates of Zion More than all the dwellings of Jacob.

segments.text: Jehovah loveth the gates of Zion
More than all the dwellings of Jacob.

verses.text: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. [Selah

segments.text: Glorious things are spoken of thee,

verses.text: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon as among them that know me: Behold, Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia: This one was born there.

segments.text: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon as among them that know me:
Behold, Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia:

verses.text: Yea, of Zion it shall be said, This one and that one was born in her; And the Most High himself will establish her.

segments.text: Yea, of Zion it shall be said, This one and that one was born in her;
And the Most High himself will establish her.

verses.text: Jehovah will count, when he writeth up the peoples, This one was born there. [Selah

segments.text: Jehovah will count, when he writeth up the peoples,

verses.text: They that sing as well as they that dance shall say, All my fountains are in thee.

segments.text: They that sing as well as they that dance
All my fountains are in thee.

headings.text: A Psalm of the sons of Korah; a Song.
